name: Functional Reach Test
description: Maximum distance patient can reach forward beyond arm's length while maintaining a fixed base of support. Measured in inches or cm.
shirleySays: ICC 0.89–0.98. MDC: ~4.1 cm. Validated in elderly, stroke, PD, vestibular, COPD, and TBI. Quick to administer (<5 min). Lateral Reach Test extends utility to mediolateral stability.

scoring.range: Distance in inches or cm (higher = better)
